body: Read-only review against ThermoMapper HEAD 64d98a4. Unit: statistical and implementation claims; order: dependency stages and repair history; external model: current source, tests, and prior BASS port constraints. Preparation reports complete through 3.3; 3.4 diagnostics/accumulators, 3.5 rerun, 3.6 cleanup and 3.7/3.8 behavior changes remain planned. Investigate whether scale-aware pivot admission supports its accuracy claim, whether likelihood paths really start at the prior, and whether recorded validation artifacts cover the implementation. Full preparation text inspected via saved line slices because the current MCP exposes no mdnav_read or batch_read method.

Confirmed two compiled in-memory probes with no source edits: ContaminatedNormalWeights(pi=.05,kappa=10,sigma2=1) returns weights .01,.01,.01,1,1 for residuals 8,100,380,400,1000; ordinary densities both underflow for the last two and NaN responsibility selects full weight. DenseCholesky on A=L L^T, L diagonal 1 and subdiagonal 2, n=25 reports MinRelativePivot=.2 and PivotRatio=1 although condition number of the diagonally equilibrated matrix is at least 375299968947541, from its inverse (0,0). Supports correction of the six-digit admission rationale, not a claimed factorization bug. Recorded 0.6 manifests confirm 178/24/5 passes. Fresh Samplers suite could not launch testhost despite cached dependency existing. Concurrent edits to diagnostics and BAPS appeared after review began; hold review against HEAD 64d98a4 and do not alter their files.

Second confirmed robust issue: BandedGPrior.Fit admits both G and Pa, but the exact Gamma/Bernoulli weight update does not condition on admission of Pa. With n=40, x_i=(i+.5)/40, cubic basis and one knot 1.05*x_0, y_i=sin(6*x_i)+.1*cos(17*i), the null-weight marginal is -4.71417061961213; weights all 1 except w_0=.01 give -Infinity and SampleCoefficients gives NaN. Such weights are in the contaminated-normal conditional's support. BarsEnsemble replaces the target at the unchanged knot state immediately after drawing them and then exposes that state for accumulation. Thus the update need not preserve the numerically truncated joint target, independently of the tail-underflow issue. The affected source files are unchanged from 64d98a4; concurrent commits b1e666f and 7c32a75 concern normal quantiles and diagnostic naming. Endpoint review: a finite prior with L=0 has log density -Infinity even at b=0, by SeparableEvaluation policy. This is valid as a declared restricted reference but is not an unrestricted prior start for SMC; normalization/support must be explicit.

Final review distinction: (1) confirmed present robust correctness defects are contaminated-normal tail underflow and unconditioned weight redraws crossing the weighted-factor admission boundary; (2) planned contract clarifications are minimum-relative-pivot being a rejection heuristic, not a six-digit accuracy guarantee; b=0 retaining negative-infinite likelihoods defines a restricted reference, not necessarily the original prior; and keeping mergeable readout statistics, ordered per-chain diagnostics, and complete execution checkpoints separate. Latest stored harness manifests independently verified 57/57 Samplers and 193/193 Regression on 2026-10-21; historical Phase 0 baseline 178+24+5=207 also verified. Fresh dotnet test launched no tests because Microsoft.TestPlatform.TestHost/17.14.1 could not be resolved at runtime, despite the cached DLL existing. In-memory compiled probes against actual assemblies did execute. Concurrent diagnostics commits advanced HEAD from review anchor 64d98a4 to f80efae; final git diff confirms prep brief and all source paths underlying reported defects and contract observations unchanged. No implementation, tests, or briefs edited by this review; only durable mdnav state added.

Read-only re-review at 1783921e7472c61b0fe4c88fd53144d73086b15c, with user's existing modification tests/regression/MixingBenchmark.cs preserved. The five earlier findings are addressed in source or explicitly scoped to the SMC stage. Current MCP exposes index/outline/journal but no mdnav_read; literal sections are read through saved Nu line slices, so coverage is not a complete reading ledger. This session's discovery assigned prep brief D002 and full-port D001; older journal document IDs must be interpreted using their prior run/source paths. New in-memory compiled probes against current assemblies confirm: constant response 0 is ZeroResponse, but constant 1 with n=40, x=(i+.5)/40, cubic basis, no interior knots scores 1378.2082970804202 and variance 6.98e-33; projection roundoff makes S positive. Constant 7 and 1000 also admitted. Shared DrawSample lets zero-weight draws influence weighted quantiles: values 10 and 20 with weights .5 each, plus (-100,0), yield q05=-78; all-zero mass sample (123,0) yields median123. Third smaller numerical API issue: floored 1x1 BandCholesky of [1e-20] estimates equilibrated condition1e-8, whereas any positive1x1matrix has condition1; normalization reads original A while solve reads floored factor. Strict BARS admission avoids that path. Further review will distinguish these correctness issues from acknowledged checkpoint and SMC deferrals.

Further compiled probe confirms DrawSample violates merge-order invariance even with strictly positive weights: A={(0,1)}, B={(0,3),(1,1)}; quantile(.7) of A merged with B is .5, B merged with A is0. Tied locations need aggregation or a stated tie-invariant weighted quantile rule; zero-weight samples must not contribute and zero total mass must be unavailable. A separate statistical tradeoff of the new NullFit centre is now measured: intercept-only n40, 39 responses0 plus one outlierR, all weights1 except outlier1e-12. NullFit conditional posterior mean is .625,6.25,625 for R=1e3,1e4,1e6; Zero gives 2.5e-11,2.5e-10,2.5e-8. Exactly, as outlier weight tends0, mean=R/n^2 because plain sample mean enters the prior. This is a model/robustness decision, not an incorrect Gibbs conditional. Should be explicit before BASS D03 reuse; location equivariance alone does not settle robust centering or empirical-Bayes evidence. Verified existing manifests230 regression then241 after centering;82 samplers64 linalg. Fresh no-build tests passed82 samplers,64 linalg,26 targeted regression covering centres, robust weights, birth density, Poisson prior and resume. Known OQ9 reference-diagnostics oracle and OQ10 persistent parameter-complete checkpoint identity remain future qualification boundaries; BARS stopping/hot-end/default-tuning parked decisions do not block BASS.
